workload.tool_gap_policy: Use the prior Terminal-Bench replay policy of zero additional tool delay
workload.max_tokens_policy: Original Qwen replay budget rule max(8192, source completion tokens), with natural EOS
workload.arrival_policy: Every original root is a timed request with its own original successor. Some roots are offered earlier than other sibling roots with a compatible original checkpoint. The later root and successor waves are fixed. Every successor still waits for its own original predecessor.

arrival_order_screen.assumptions: Potential totals assume complete remote reads after P changes. Existing hybrid checkpoints, early root releases and actual P routing can reduce demand.

cold_arrival_guard.reason: Leave room for the first large HTTP request and the initial request-body preparation delays observed in the parent replay.

root_batch_calibration.assumptions: One potential full remote read per distinct original checkpoint. Earlier requests must publish this state before the later root needs it. Native service and APC may change the measured amount.

shaping: D egress only across eight equal port limits; all eight P ports read-only at original 200000 Mbps
